description: WARC/CDX interoperability and integrity fixes across web/lib/warc_writer.js, web/lib/warc_reader.js, cli/aegis_cli.py, cli/warc_verify.py and mcp/server.py: strip encoding/framing headers and rewrite Content-Length to the stored payload, emit the CDX record-length field S (11 fields) and fix reader/MCP indices, throw instead of mislabelled FNV fallback digests, add WARC-Refers-To on revisit records, resolve revisit records in the reader, implement warc_verify --cdx and .warc.gz input, and add synthesised request records with WARC-Concurrent-To; plus stdlib-only tests.
